mapper.sql: id, trace_id, level, exception_type, error_message, request_method, request_uri, operator_id, operator_name, ip, user_agent, handle_status, handle_remark, handler_id, handler_name, handle_time, version, create_time, update_time
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO `error_log` (trace_id, level, exception_type, error_message, request_method, request_uri, operator_id, operator_name, ip, user_agent, stack_trace, create_time) VALUES (#{traceId}, #{level}, #{exceptionType}, #{errorMessage}, #{requestMethod}, #{requestUri}, #{operatorId}, #{operatorName}, #{ip}, #{userAgent}, #{stackTrace}, #{createTime})
mapper.update: UPDATE `error_log` SET handle_status = #{handleStatus}, handle_remark = #{handleRemark}, handler_id = #{handlerId}, handler_name = #{handlerName}, handle_time = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, version = version + 1 WHERE id = #{id} AND version = #{version}
